C1584.title: Cyberspace Security Challenge: Hardware Homogeneity Flaws Leading to Large-Scale Supply Chain Attacks
C1584.summary: On November 25, 2021, an article in the Bulletin of Chinese Academy of Sciences pointed out that large-scale destructive attacks primarily exploit homogeneity flaws in the software and hardware of critical information infrastructure.
